Philadelphia teacher lied for years about being Black: ‘I am a white woman of significant privilege and wealth’

Sandra Rose
September 26, 2026
Facebook
X
Pinterest
WhatsApp
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:55
    Instaread

    A Jewish teacher and community activist in Philadelphia admits she lied for years about being a Black Palestinian.

    Hannah Gann, a 34-year-old teacher, apologized for deceiving the Philadelphia community. Gann teaches at the Workshop School, a Philadelphia School District high school.

    Gann was exposed by two local activist groups, the Racial Justice Organizing Committee and Philly Educators for Palestine.

    The groups confronted Gann about being a White Jewish woman. After an hour of denials, Gann admitted that she had lied for years about her identity.

    In a post on her Instagram account, Gann admitted she is “a white woman of significant privilege and wealth.”

    “I lied about my identity and have been lying for years. I have no Palestinian or Tunisian heritage. I am a white woman of significant privilege and wealth. Anyone who supported me was manipulated and should not be judged as a result of their support for me.”

    In a follow-up post, she wrote: “Any adults leaving nasty comments about my students: it is sickening and disgusting. The only reason I’m leaving this page up is so you can come at me, not them. Pick on someone your own age.”

    Gann is a prominent left-wing activist who portrayed herself as a Black Palestinian who opposed Israel.

    Her activism led someone to drive a mobile billboard outside her school labeling her “Philadelphia’s Leading Antisemite.”

    A former Pennsylvania classmate told the Philadelphia Inquirer that Gann was known in college as “a self-proclaimed white Jewish woman with family in the occupied West Bank.”

    “I watched her sudden transformation after she returned to Philly from the Peace Corps [in Rwanda]. She was clearly making herself look darker using makeup and fake tan, and speaking using [Black English],” the classmate said.

    A video from December 2025 showed Gann wearing a keffiyeh and speaking with a fake accent that was noticeably different than her accent in her recent Instagram post.
